_comment: Lane map for concurrent Claude sessions sharing ONE checkout of this repo (data-driven per docs/design/infinite-of-x.md: add a lane here, not in code). A lane is a DOMAIN of work, not a directory: a single change can legitimately touch src/, web/, docs/ and tests/ within one lane. Read with `just lanes`. This is advisory, it tells you what someone else is probably editing right now so you do not clobber them; the mechanical protection is that `just ship` only commits what you staged. Shared files listed at the bottom are the ones most likely to collide.

lanes.label: ABYSSAL adoption arc: ocean disaster events, lightning, waterspout, foam, spray, rain (carved out of engine while active)
lanes._note: Active 2026-08-28+, operator-approved ('Let's do all of it'). Claimed by the ABYSSAL-arc session (the one that authored docs/reference/abyssal-ocean-weather.md). These files are carved out of the engine lane while the arc runs. The cloud session keeps 40-clouds.wgsl / 41-cloud-bodies.wgsl / 45-cloud-temporal.wgsl and src/renderer/cloud_*.rs exclusively; rung 10 (cloud env probe in water reflections) is a crossover and gets scheduled with the cloud session, not around it. Water shader tails this lane must touch (00-bindings-vertex.wgsl, 20-surface-detail.wgsl, 90-fragment-main.wgsl) stay SHARED per the list below: small serial edits, re-read immediately before editing.

lanes.label: Higgsfield festival intro film (movie-only session; does NOT push)
lanes._note: Active Aug 2026 until the Sep 3 festival deadline. This session works ONLY on the film (operator directive 2026-08-15): it edits docs/outreach/film/* locally and never commits or pushes. GAME SESSIONS: please sweep docs/outreach/film/ changes into your next normal push (stage them by name alongside your own work, a plain docs change, no version implications beyond your usual bump). Film state of record: docs/outreach/film/intro-film-script.md + memory project_higgsfield_film.md. docs/outreach/film/ is carved out of the ui lane's docs/ ownership while this lane is active.

shared._comment: Touched by every lane, so they are where concurrent edits actually collide. Keep your edit small, re-read the file immediately before editing, and never reformat.
